assertions.assertion: CPT 93229 is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and presyncope
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease
The diagnosis code I49.5 corresponds to sick sinus syndrome
The diagnosis code I25.10 corresponds to atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient had a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
The diagnosis code G45.9 corresponds to transient cerebral ischemic attack
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of cerebral hypoperfusion and to optimize rate control
The ordered service is directly supported by the documented diagnoses and indications
The denial is based on precertification
